task: Present live audit tests, findings and points in clear business-owner language.
nonGoals: Backend, rubric, credential, usage-policy or scoring changes; invented website findings or replacement product facts; merging without a user request.

outcomes.description: The report list shows every returned check by a readable name and explicit Pass, Fail, Not completed or Not applicable result with measured points.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen fixtures and status/point boundary regressions, including partial credit and effective weights.

outcomes.description: Selecting a test shows its actual source-linked finding and a plain-language explanation, with no Where, Owner or Rule blocks.
outcomes.evidence: Runtime rendering verifies visible source findings, absent confusing labels and safe untrusted content handling.

outcomes.description: An incomplete audit still displays measured results and explains remaining tests without inventing a final score or historical point changes.
outcomes.evidence: Independent source review and responsive browser checks using retained test data.

process.description: Commit plan first, independently review and run source-bound commands and hosted CI before release.
process.evidence: Git chronology, actual evaluation and review.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the approved report style, write for business owners, and retain source evidence with no new dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Customer report presentation does not alter agent workflow, portability or resumability.
